eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Armed Forces/CAPF personnel domiciled in Delhi (NCT) OR serving Delhi Police/Civil Defence.

benefit.summary_en: ₹1,00,00,000 ex-gratia financial honour to eligible next-of-kin for line-of-duty martyrdom per GNCTD rules [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
